evidence.title: DARS: Dual-Level Credit Assignment RL with Structured Reasoning for Instruction-Based Image Editing

summary: The new DARS framework combines a two‑tier credit assignment mechanism with structured reasoning to better interpret textual instructions for editing images. Experiments demonstrate that DARS outperforms existing reinforcement‑learning approaches on standard instruction‑based editing benchmarks.
title: Researchers introduce DARS, a dual‑level credit‑assignment RL model with structured reasoning for instruction‑based image editing
